title: The Malagasy Uprising of 1947
description: On the night of March 29–30, 1947, a coordinated uprising against French colonial rule broke out across Madagascar's eastern coast. The revolt was brutally suppressed — the death toll, disputed to this day, is estimated in the tens of thousands; subsequent famine and disease caused further deaths. The uprising marked a turning point in Malagasy consciousness: a historical wound simultaneously suppressed and foundational, shaping the political and cultural imagination of independence and everything that followed. Raymond Rajaonarivelo's Tabataba (1988) and Marie-Clémence Paes's Fahavalo, Madagascar 1947 (2018) are the two most significant cinematic engagements with this event.
